'''Black bullheads''' are an aquatic [[vermin]] found year-round in [[biome|temperate]] [[water|freshwater]] [[pool|lakes]], and are a ready source of [[food]] when [[fish cleaning|cleaned]] at a [[fishery]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] black bullheads for their ''whiskers''.
